Who We Are

SEA stands for Studio for Eclectic Architecture. We don’t carry one signature style from project to project. We start with the site, the climate and the people who will use the building, and let those decide the form.

The studio is a team of architects, interior designers and 3D artists. Visualisation sits inside the design team, not after it, so every decision is seen in 3D before it is drawn for construction.
